text: The automated phone system asked him to say his account number for the fourth time and then told him it did not understand and sent him back to the main menu
She had untangled the same knot in the necklace chain for twenty minutes and every time she loosened one loop another one pulled tight somewhere else
The printer said it was out of paper and he opened the tray and it was full and he closed it and the printer said it was out of paper again
She was three cars from the front of the line when the traffic light turned red for the fifth time and the car at the front still had not moved

He explained the problem to the customer service agent from the beginning, every detail, and the agent said he would need to transfer the call to another department where he would have to explain it all again
The jar lid would not turn no matter how hard she gripped it, and she ran it under hot water and tapped it on the counter and wrapped it in a towel and it still would not move
The code compiled without errors and ran without errors and still produced the wrong number, and he had been staring at the same forty lines since lunch
She told her teenage son to take out the trash for the third time that evening and he said in a minute without looking up from his phone, the same thing he had said the first two times
The flight was delayed an hour, then two hours, then four, each announcement coming just as the last estimated time passed, and nobody at the gate could tell him why
He assembled the bookshelf following every step in the diagram and at the end there were six screws left over and the shelf leaned to the left
She had spent an hour filling out the online form and when she clicked submit the page timed out and every field came back empty
The toddler refused the pasta he had asked for ten minutes earlier and pushed the bowl off the high chair tray and it landed upside down on the floor that had just been mopped
In the meeting he proposed the idea and nobody responded, and five minutes later his coworker said the same idea in almost the same words and everyone nodded and the boss wrote it down
The wifi showed full bars but the page would not load, and she restarted the router and waited and restarted the laptop and waited and the little wheel just kept spinning
He had practiced the guitar chord change every night for two weeks and his fingers still landed half a second late and the strings buzzed every single time
The landlord promised again to fix the leaking faucet by Friday, the same promise he had made the previous three Fridays, and the drip kept going in the dark kitchen all night
She was searching for her keys with ten minutes until the interview, checking every pocket and every counter and the couch cushions twice, and they were nowhere
The vending machine took his last dollar and the bag of chips moved forward and stuck against the glass, hanging by one corner from the metal coil
He asked the clerk for the form and was told he needed a different form first, and that form required a document that could only be picked up in person at an office that was closed on weekdays
The group project was due tomorrow and two of the four members still had not replied to any messages, and she sat alone at the library table doing their sections
The tent poles would not fit into the sleeves in the wind, the nylon snapping and flapping, and every time he got one end in the other end slipped out and the whole thing collapsed again
She was explaining her side of the argument and her husband kept interrupting before she could finish a sentence, and she stopped and started over and he interrupted again
The software update was supposed to take ten minutes and the progress bar had been stuck at ninety-nine percent for forty-five of them
He parallel parked, pulled out, tried again, pulled out, and the car behind him honked while he was still a foot from the curb and crooked
The crossword was finished except for one square, and she knew both words had to be right, and she went through every letter of the alphabet and none of them made sense
The insurance company denied the claim for the second time, citing a missing document he had already sent them twice, once by mail and once by fax
The dog had dug up the newly planted bulbs again, the third morning in a row, and the soil was scattered across the patio she had just swept
He had rewritten the opening paragraph of the essay eleven times and every version was worse than the one before and the cursor kept blinking at the start of the empty page
The store did not have her size in the shoes, and the website said they were in stock at the store, and the clerk said the website was wrong and there was nothing she could do
The construction crew started drilling outside his window at seven in the morning on the only day all month he could have slept in
She had asked the doctor's office three times to send her test results and each time someone said they would call back, and the phone sat silent on the table all week
The tape kept tearing at an angle instead of straight across, and the end disappeared back onto the roll, and he picked at it with his fingernail trying to find the edge
The bus pulled away from the stop just as she reached it, close enough that she slapped the side, and the driver looked at her in the mirror and kept going
He had been on hold for fifty minutes listening to the same eight seconds of music, and when someone finally answered the line went dead
The video game boss killed her at the exact same spot for the thirtieth time, the same attack she knew was coming and still could not dodge
Every time he tried to explain to his elderly father how to answer a video call, his father pressed a different button, and the screen went black, and the phone rang again
The parking garage was full on every level and she drove up the ramp to the top and back down again, past a sign at the entrance that still said spaces available
The zipper on the jacket caught on the fabric halfway up and would not go up or down, and he pulled harder and the fabric bunched tighter into the teeth
The committee sent the proposal back for revisions again, asking her to change it back to the version she had submitted two rounds earlier
He tried to cut the cardboard box open and the key slid off the packing tape again and again, and inside the box was another box wrapped in more tape
